name: Sun Ray does not announce a Sunflare learn on every Burning Heat proc (#4288)
contract: #4288: 'everytime proc happens im leaning [sic] Sunflare spell and it shows on pop out window'. Burning Heat 704908 triggers 707529, which stacks the buff 803238; AscensionSunCleric::Refresh (sun_cleric_player::OnPlayerUpdate, every 500 ms) grants Sun Ray 504764 while 803238 is up and Sunflare 800231 is known, and revokes it when the buff drops (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:372-379). Player::learnSpell(spellId, true) reaches Player::_addSpell with announce=true, whose own guard (Player.cpp, around _addSpell) sends SMSG_LEARNED_SPELL for any temporary grant that is not passive/DO_NOT_DISPLAY and has no SPELL_EFFECT_LEARN_SPELL effect; Sun Ray has neither, so every proc cycle sent the client a New Spell Learned toast. The fix grants it with Player::learnSpellWithoutAnnouncement(504764), the same call already used for Blood Curse/Sanguine Essence (#6721) and other temporary replacements in this tree. The buff is applied directly (set_aura) across two independent proc cycles, each followed by the buff dropping, to prove the toast stays suppressed on a repeat grant and not only the first one.

steps.label: First proc: gain the Sun Ray buff
SETUP: the buff replaces Sunflare with Sun Ray
THE FIX: the first grant of Sun Ray is not announced as a learned spell
The buff drops, Sun Ray is revoked
Second proc: gain the Sun Ray buff again
SETUP: the buff replaces Sunflare with Sun Ray again
THE FIX: the repeat grant across a second proc cycle stays unannounced
